content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint definition lacks estimand components",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint is ORR, defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of CR or PR based on Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1).",
      "page": 46,
      "section": "2.2.1 Primary Endpoint",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint is described only as a statistical definition; the protocol does not specify the estimand (population, intercurrent event strategy, population-level summary) as required by ICH M11 and SPIRIT 2025. This omission creates ambiguity in how the treatment effect will be estimated, especially in the presence of treatment discontinuation or death.",
      "fix": "Add a formal estimand section for the primary endpoint, specifying the target population, the intercurrent event strategies (e.g., treatment policy, composite), and the population-level summary measure (e.g., difference in proportions)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent statement on treatment duration",
      "quote": "All subjects will receive vidutolimod and cemiplimab according to the treatment schedule up to 2 years or until a reason for treatment discontinuation is reached.",
      "page": 49,
      "section": "3.1 Overall Study Design",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The synopsis (not provided) and the body text may conflict on the exact treatment duration. The body states 'up to 2 years' but later says 'At the end of the treatment period (2 years), the Sponsor will not continue to provide supplied study treatment'—this is internally consistent, but the protocol lacks a clear definition of 'treatment period' and whether 2 years is from first dose or from a fixed calendar date. This ambiguity could lead to operational confusion.",
      "fix": "Clarify the start and end of the 2-year treatment period (e.g., 2 years from first dose) and specify whether the 2-year cap applies to each drug individually or the combination."
    },
    {
      "title": "Contraception requirements not specified",
      "quote": "The secondary endpoints are as follows: • AEs, SAEs, and AEs leading to discontinuation or death, and severity of AEs as assessed by the National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events Version 5.0 (CTCAE v5.0)",
      "page": 46,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol text provided does not include any contraception requirements for participants, which is a critical omission for a study involving investigational drugs with potential teratogenicity. The thin/missing list flags M11 5.4 Contraception as missing, and no contraception details appear in the provided text.",
      "fix": "Add a dedicated contraception section specifying requirements for males and females of childbearing potential, including acceptable methods, duration of use, and pregnancy testing schedule."
    },
    {
      "title": "No trial stopping rules or discontinuation criteria for the trial",
      "quote": "Subjects who discontinue study treatment should complete the end of treatment (EOT) visit.",
      "page": 49,
      "section": "3.1 Overall Study Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol describes individual treatment discontinuation but does not provide any trial-level stopping rules (e.g., based on safety, futility, or efficacy). The thin/missing list flags M11 4.3 Trial Stopping Rules as missing, and no such rules are present in the provided text.",
      "fix": "Add a section on trial stopping rules, including criteria for pausing or terminating the trial due to safety concerns, futility, or other reasons, and the process for decision-making."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent definition of 'PD-1–blocking antibody' with typo",
      "quote": "Cohort C2: Subjects who have progressed while receiving a PD-1–-blocking antibody or within 12 weeks of discontinuation",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3.1 Overall Study Design",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "There is a typographical error with a double hyphen 'PD-1–-blocking' in Cohort C2, which is inconsistent with the correct phrasing used elsewhere (e.g., 'PD-1–blocking antibody' in Cohort A2). This could cause confusion in the protocol text.",
      "fix": "Correct the typo to 'PD-1–blocking antibody' for consistency."
    },
    {
      "title": "No details on management of loss to follow-up",
      "quote": "Subjects who are posttreatment but have not met criteria for study discontinuation should remain on study for posttreatment follow-up (PTFU), which includes disease assessments every 3 months until discontinuation.",
      "page": 49,
      "section": "3.1 Overall Study Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol mentions follow-up but does not describe procedures for managing participants who are lost to follow-up, such as attempts to contact, documentation, or handling of missing data. The thin/missing list flags M11 7.3 Management of Loss to Follow-Up as missing.",
      "fix": "Add a section on loss to follow-up management, including the minimum number of contact attempts, documentation requirements, and how missing data will be handled in the analysis."
    },
    {
      "title": "No sample size determination or power calculations provided",
      "quote": "This is a multicenter, open-label, Phase 2 clinical study of vidutolimod administered by IT injection in combination with cemiplimab IV in subjects with selected types of advanced or metastatic cancer",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3.1 Overall Study Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol text does not include any sample size determination, power calculations, or assumptions about effect sizes. The thin/missing list flags M11 10.11 Sample Size Determination as thin, and no numerical details are provided in the text.",
      "fix": "Add a sample size section for each cohort, including the expected response rate, alpha, power, and the formula or simulation used, with justification for the chosen sample size."
    },
    {
      "title": "No data sharing or patient and public involvement statements",
      "quote": "At the end of the treatment period (2 years), the Sponsor will not continue to provide supplied study treatment to subjects/investigators unless the Sponsor chooses to extend the study.",
      "page": 49,
      "section": "3.1 Overall Study Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol lacks any statement on data sharing (SPIRIT 6) and patient and public involvement (SPIRIT 11), both flagged as missing. These are required by SPIRIT 2025 for transparency and patient engagement.",
      "fix": "Add sections on data sharing (e.g., plan to share de-identified data, when and where) and patient and public involvement (e.g., how patients were involved in design or will be informed of results)."
    }
  ]
}
